title: The Euler Characteristic of Finite Subset Spaces
summary: For a topological space $X$, the space of finite subsets $\mathrm{Sub}_n X$ consists of non-empty subsets of $X$ of cardinality at most $n$. We compute the Euler characteristic of $\mathrm{Sub}_n X$ for any space $X$ having the homotopy type of a finite CW complex. We obtain the explicit formula $χ(\mathrm{Sub}_n X) = \sum_{i=1}^n \binom{χ(X)}{i}$.
